$comment: AE/CEP quirk table (docs/06 §5 release step 1). Data, not code — capability probes consult it, docs/08 tracks verification on real AE.

quirks.summary: LayerCollection has no .length; iterate comp.numLayers + comp.layer(i).
app.scheduleTask evaluates a global code string; closures cannot be scheduled — chunk continuations must address $._OP._tick(id).
evalScript blocks the AE UI thread; batch work must be chunked with scheduled continuation (task protocol).
Windows backslashes must be escaped in $.evalFile source; paths travel as JSON.stringify literals.
Node sidecar requires manifest CEFCommandLine flags; feature-detect `require`, degrade to Limited mode when absent.
ExtendScript is ES3: no JSON, no Array.isArray/indexOf/trim/Object.keys, no getters; avoid reserved-word property names; no trailing commas.
